notes: Source = S. 494 Engrossed in Senate (ES), 4376 chars, read in full. No referencedSources registered/needed (self-contained; no cross-references). One operative section (SEC. 2): 2(a) directs HHS to review and, as necessary and appropriate, recommend to Congress and update EXISTING Federal epilepsy programs/activities/strategic plans (research, prevention, early identification, diagnosis, treatment); 2(b)(1)-(4) enumerate required review content; 2(c) requires regularly convening/soliciting input from other Federal agencies (as appropriate) and relevant stakeholders incl. patient advocates and non-Federal subject matter experts; 2(d) requires a report to Senate HELP and House Energy & Commerce within 2 years, with 3 enumerated components. All substantive bill-description claims are source-supported; coverage is complete (no material omission). The only flags are non-material: sponsor/cosponsor metadata in likelihoodReason (structural, not in engrossed text) and two extrinsic why_unreported gloss claims (SUDEP epidemiology / advocacy-priority framing). No divisions[], criticisms, or featured_quotes to audit. Stage/vote cross-check: 'Passed the Senate August 4, 2026' in source matches votes[] and stage 'Passed Senate' — no drift.
